title: Test follows an outdated spec, code follows the newer ADR
presentedFailure: AssertionFailedError: expected <7> but was <10> in freeStorageLasts7Days. The two retrieved documents disagree: docs/SPEC.md says 7 days, ADR-007 says 10 days and states that it supersedes the SPEC.
knownRootCause: The production value (10 days) follows ADR-007, which supersedes the 7 days still written in the 'Storage fees' section of docs/SPEC.md. The test encodes the outdated value. The correct fix is to update the test (and the SPEC), not to change the code back to 7.
expectedEvidence: The actual value 10 matches ADR-007 ('The free storage period ... is 10 days').
ADR-007 status: Accepted, supersedes the 7 days of the SPEC, which 'has not been updated yet'.
docs/SPEC.md 'Storage fees' still says 7 days, so the two documents conflict.
The sibling test storageBeyondTheFreePeriodIsCharged (11 days charged) passes, consistent with 10.

expectedLimitationsContain: No execution log output was available
retrieval.answerability: Answerable: both documents are retrieved. StoragePolicy.java is NOT retrieved, but the actual value 10 and ADR-007 are enough.

manualChecks: The diagnosis names the conflict between docs/SPEC.md and ADR-007 and says which one prevails.
The proposed fix updates the test (and the SPEC) and does not change the production value back to 7.
